chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, who said:
I wrote to Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام): "Khums—should I pay it before the expenses, or after the expenses?" So he wrote: "After the expenses."

key_terms.أُخْرِجُهُ: I bring it out or pay it out
key_terms.الْخُمُسُ: khums, the one-fifth religious due under specified legal conditions
key_terms.الْمَئُونَةِ: expenses, maintenance costs, or necessary provision

ai.seo_question: Is khums calculated before expenses or after expenses?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning khums: it is to be taken after deducting one's expenses. The report is brief and directly answers a written question addressed to Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), making it an important text in discussions of khums calculation.
